name: Ongoing Operations & Governance (SDLC Phase 15)
description: Establishing long-term operational excellence — aka SRE & Ops, Continuous Improvement, Risk & Compliance Governance.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Ongoing Operations & Governance
capabilities.description: Sustains long-term operational reliability, compliance, and architectural health through recurring governance practices.

checklists.name: Ongoing Operations & Governance (SDLC Phase 15) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for operational SRE playbooks, change management, and technical debt governance.

items.statement: The tech debt register is reviewed and updated on a recurring cadence rather than left stale after creation.
Disaster recovery failover simulation drill is conducted annually with documented recovery times.
Compliance audit evidence catalog is refreshed continuously to satisfy external auditor requests.
SRE error budget policies determine release freeze thresholds whenever SLI targets are breached.
Quarterly architecture reviews record approved refactoring allocations for the upcoming engineering sprint.

reviewGates.name: Operational Readiness Review
reviewGates.statement: The Runbook / Operational Documentation (SRE playbook, business continuity plan) has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient for ongoing operations.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Runbook / Operational Documentation sufficiently cover incident response, change management, and business continuity for steady-state operations?
